lyrics:
[Intro: marching piano figure, soft kick]

[Verse 1: female voice, worried]
You fell asleep at eight again
The dishes and the news still on
We haven't had a conversation
That wasn't schedules since the fall
I lie here doing the arithmetic
Of when we last were us at all

[Pre-Chorus: female, drums entering]
Tell me that it's still in there
Tell me I'm not making it up

[Chorus: both voices, full band]
Tired isn't over
Quiet isn't gone
We're not broken, baby, we're just behind on sleep
And it's been so long
Give me a morning, one slow morning, and we'll count again
Tired isn't over
We just have to get to the weekend

[Verse 2: male voice, gentle, a little amused]
You've been reading into silence
I've been dead on my two feet
I still look at you in the kitchen
When you think I'm half asleep
I know the nights have all been short ones
You're still the one I'd stay up to keep

[Pre-Chorus: male, drums pushing]
It's still in there, I swear it is
You're not making it up

[Chorus: both voices, full band]
Tired isn't over
Quiet isn't gone
We're not broken, baby, we're just behind on sleep
And it's been so long
Give me a morning, one slow morning, and we'll count again
Tired isn't over
We just have to get to the weekend

[Bridge: piano alone, voices trading]
Your mother takes the kids on Friday
We turn our phones face down
I'll make the coffee. You sleep till ten.
And then we look around.

[Final Chorus: key up a step, both voices at full strength]
Tired isn't over
Quiet isn't gone
We're not broken, baby, we're just behind on sleep
And it's been so long
Give me a morning, one slow morning, and we'll count again
Tired isn't over
We just have to get to the weekend

[Outro: piano figure, a yawn, a laugh]
producerBrief:
TEMPO / KEY / FEEL: 95 BPM, 4/4, G major, up to A major for the last chorus. A steady, marching mid-tempo ballad.

VOICE: A duet. The woman has a strong, raspy, direct pop-rock voice and sings verse 1 anxiously. The man has a high, clear, theatrical tenor and answers warmly in verse 2. They sing the choruses together in harmony at full strength, and trade lines in the bridge.

INSTRUMENTS: A piano playing a marching eighth-note figure, a kick and snare with a military feel, bass, strummed acoustic guitar, a string section from the second chorus, electric guitar chords in the last chorus.

ARRANGEMENT MAP: 0:00 Intro piano. 0:10 Verse 1, her. 0:42 Pre-chorus. 0:52 Chorus 1. 1:22 Verse 2, him. 1:54 Pre-chorus. 2:04 Chorus 2. 2:34 Bridge, piano. 2:54 Final chorus, key up. 3:26 Outro, a yawn and a laugh, ends 3:46.

PRODUCTION & MIX: Early-2010s pop-rock ballad: bright, punchy and clean, piano and both voices forward.

SIGNATURE MOMENT: 'We're not broken, baby, we're just behind on sleep' at 1:00.

MODERN POINT OF VIEW: The original couple fear the love has gone. This one, twenty years in, discovers the difference between falling out of love and being worn out by a shared life.

EMOTIONAL ARC: Frightened, reassured, planning, laughing.
